title: Remove dead sample packages and committed cruft for the open-source release
description: Pre-open-source cleanup. Three sample/dogfood projects under packages/ (cli-guess-number, python-demo, python-rps) and three tracked junk/dead files at the repo root (du.exe.stackdump, jek.md, claude-session.mjs) are not part of the Lattice tool and have zero live references. They should be removed so the open-source repo ships only the actual product. The lab benchmark subsystem and experiments/ are intentionally OUT of scope for this story (separate follow-up).
